prompt: Design a custom generic Stack data structure in C# backed by a dynamic array that automatically resizes when capacity is exceeded.

criterion_scores.name: Generics Usage (0-5)
criterion_scores.justification: The response defines a generic class DynamicStack<T> with proper <T> usage throughout.

criterion_scores.name: Array Resizing (0-5)
criterion_scores.justification: It implements doubling capacity on push and shrinking when below 25% usage with proper Array.Resize calls.
